name: @marketak/ui
description: Design tokens shared by the admin console and the mobile app. Tokens only, no components.

comments.antdIsOptionalPeer: antd is an OPTIONAL peer. Only theme/antd-theme.ts needs it, and the mobile app loads this package without it - so `import { space } from '@marketak/ui'` must work in a React Native bundle that has no antd installed. A required peer would make the mobile app install a desktop UI kit to read a spacing scale.
